name: Amlodipine/valsartan/hydrochlorothiazide
className: Calcium channel blocker, angiotensin II receptor blocker and thiazide diuretic combination

availability.note: No UK product information found for a fixed-dose amlodipine/valsartan/hydrochlorothiazide tablet. Searched 2026-10-17: emc (medicines.org.uk) by ingredient combination and by the clinic trade name (only amlodipine/valsartan and valsartan/hydrochlorothiazide products listed); MHRA products (SPC/PIL index) by the three-ingredient combination and by trade names (only two-ingredient products and an olmesartan/amlodipine/hydrochlorothiazide combination found). Single-ingredient and two-ingredient UK products exist but are not this product. Re-checked 2026-10-17 in the independent audit: the emc search for hydrochlorothiazide (56 results) lists no amlodipine/valsartan/hydrochlorothiazide product (the only amlodipine-containing triple is olmesartan/amlodipine/hydrochlorothiazide), and none of the MHRA products SPC/PIL records returned for hydrochlorothiazide (2,476) or valsartan (1,827) lists all three active substances. The separate UK amlodipine/valsartan, valsartan/hydrochlorothiazide and amlodipine SmPCs are not used, because they do not describe this three-ingredient product.
